coverage: Read native schematic and PCB; independently checked R1 value, pad assignments and saved F.Cu connectivity from J1.1 through R1 to J1.2.
Reviewed supplied ERC, DRC/parity, netlist and geometry records, including ignored checks and saved-zone limitations.

Calculated continuous R1 dissipation for the specified external clamp and corroborated it with an ideal ngspice operating point. Commands, assumptions and results are recorded in review-work/physical/experiments/.

findings.condition: External equipment holds /IN at 48 V DC and /OUT at 0 V indefinitely, with R1's stipulated continuous power limit of 0.1 W.

evidence.locator: line 1: imposed voltages, indefinite duration and 0.1 W continuous limit
R1 symbol UUID c5c38e1a-7593-5c99-b971-2f9d2e7bef78; lines 1263–1274 identify R1 and its 10k value
R1 value at line 256; pads 1 and 2 at lines 359–374; F.Cu segments at lines 667–697 connect J1.1–R1.1 and R1.2–J1.2
nets /IN and /OUT connect R1.1 to J1.1 and R1.2 to J1.2
centerline_connectivity and calculation: current_A=0.0048, power_W=0.2304, power_to_limit=2.304
operating-point vectors: v(in)=48 V, v(out)=0 V, r1_current=4.8 mA, r1_power=0.2304 W

findings.location: inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_pcb: R1 at (105, 100) mm, between /IN and /OUT
findings.mechanism: The maintained voltage across the 10 kΩ resistor produces continuous resistive dissipation above its stipulated limit.
findings.reasoning: The saved copper provides a complete path through R1 to the external clamp. Thus I=48/10000=4.8 mA and P=48²/10000=0.2304 W, exceeding 0.1 W by 0.1304 W, or a factor of 2.304. C1 does not interrupt this DC path. The supplied clean ERC/DRC results do not evaluate this stimulus or resistor power.
findings.title: R1 exceeds its continuous power limit under the specified clamp

limitations: No hardware temperature, damage threshold or failure-time measurement; the finding establishes violation of the supplied continuous power limit.
No manufacturer-specific tolerance, voltage-rating or thermal-derating assessment. No ampacity or thermal qualification inferred from footprint or track width.
Saved zone fill was inspected without refill. Existing native check records were reviewed rather than rerun.

Ignored ERC checks remain unverified: single_global_label, four_way_junction, simulation_model_issue and footprint_filter. Ignored DRC checks remain unverified: missing_courtyard, track_not_centered_on_via, tuning_profile_track_geometries, footprint_filters_mismatch and footprint_type_mismatch.
Fabrication-process qualification, other operating conditions and ECU qualification were outside the stated scope.
